name: B10-0406/2026 – § 14 – Am 71
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 14. Considers that the events in Ceuta demonstrate the failure of a migration model that is reliant on the externalisation of border management; stresses that the response to the so-called instrumentalisation of migration cannot consist of further externalisation, the restriction of access to international protection or the weakening of fundamental rights; calls instead for a rights-based EU migration policy grounded in solidarity, strong public reception and protection capacities and the activation and expansion of safe and legal pathways to the EU;
